blocks.text: The 2026 Miss Grand International pageant will hold its “Grand Final” show at the MGI Hall at Bravo BKK in Bangkok, Thailand, on Saturday evening, Oct. 10, with the program streamed in real time on the Grand TV YouTube channel. For this year’s competition, 78 delegates from different countries and territories are competing to inherit the title currently held by reigning queen Emma Tiglao, the second Miss Grand International titleholder from the Philippines.
